what: A5-relaxed re-analysis: gait cycles from observed kinematics, not clean GRF

segmentations.GRF: clean ground-reaction force (the registered A5 control, recomputed here on the same noise draws)
segmentations.DET_A: local maximum of the observed 6 Hz low-passed SHANK orientation, prominence 5.0 deg, min stride 0.6 s
segmentations.DET_B: local maximum of the observed 6 Hz low-passed ANKLE ANGLE, prominence 3.0 deg, min stride 0.6 s

new_for_a5.hard_failure: fewer than 2 usable cycles -> ank_rom undefined -> scored as a classification error in the primary accounting; complete-case accuracies reported alongside
